propositions: Three MCP clients (copilot, codex, claude) must be wired to connect to rebar MCP server over remote HTTP using static bearer PAT authentication

Each client requires a different config file format and location: copilot uses type:http in mcp-config.json with Authorization header, codex uses config.toml with bearer_token_env_var, claude uses .mcp.json with type:http and Authorization header
PAT credentials must be sourced from environment variables (MCP_CLIENT_PAT_*) and never committed as literals; gitignored local files reference these env vars

Hermetic acceptance test must verify real config loading, tool invocation over loopback rebar-mcp instance, rejection on invalid/absent bearer (401 response), and absence of PAT literals in committed configs
Per-client CLI acceptance checks (copilot mcp get, codex mcp list, claude mcp list) must load example configs and skip gracefully when client binary is not installed
